description: Asked after the old fourteen, and saw that the north porch was empty.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Counted the Mayor's door with him, and took Alse out by their own door.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Cut his bread no smaller than yesterday, and asked to sit at the back of the church.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat in the Mayor's pew. He did not speak. Two more servants stood at the door of it than at Easter.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Preached the gift of tongues, set the glass down after one turning, and read the Homily he had been ordered to read.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Stood in the north aisle, turned once during the second lesson, and was gone by the north porch. She did not speak.
name: the lady of the parish

description: Made the cross and wrote nothing else.
name: William Shakespeare
